fusions.name: Running Tine
fusions.desc: A lunging tine that deals 12 damage, rising to 1.6 times that at its full reach of 5 tiles, and tosses the target back 3.5 tiles. Its damage rises 5% for every 100 paces you have run since you last used it (max 25%).

fusions.name: Antler Flick
fusions.desc: Catches and tosses with your tines in a full circle, dealing 7 damage to every enemy within 2.5 tiles, and your movement speed rises 20% for 3 seconds. Holds 3 charges; each use spends one, and each kill restores one.

fusions.name: Break Away
fusions.desc: Increases your movement speed by 35% for 6 seconds and carries you 3 tiles from where you stood, with +10% dodge chance.

fusions.name: Gored in Passing
fusions.desc: Every time you avoid a blow, a stack builds on you, up to 4. When you reach 4, they all spend at once: a blow strikes the nearest enemy within 8 tiles for 27% of your weapon damage per stack (109% at full). Unfed, a stack fades every 10 seconds.
